newsitem.title: USA: IRIDEX sees Q3 results below estimates.
newsitem.headline: IRIDEX sees Q3 results below estimates.

text.p: IRIDEX Corp said Thursday it did not expect third quarter revenues and earnings to meet analysts' consensus estimates.
IRIDEX did not specify the estimates, but First Call said the consensus earnings estimate for IRIDEX's third quarter was $0.07 per share.
In the year-earlier third quarter the company earned $0.05 per share, according to First Call.
IRIDEX said it expects third quarter revenues of $2.5-$2.7 million.
It said problems in obtaining a sole-source component delayed revenue shipments of its new product, the OcuLight GL, until late in the third quarter.
However, it said early demand for the product "has been strong" and it expects to meet analysts' consensus expectations for the fourth quarter.
First Call said the consensus fourth quarter estimate was $0.15 per share. A year earlier the company earned $0.06 per share, it said.

IRIDEX, which supplies semiconductor-based photocoagulator systems to treat eye diseases, said its ability to meet fourth quarter earnings projections "continues to be dependent upon timely receipt of the sole-source component."
